title: Smeltable Raw Ore Blocks
description: A datapack that makes the raw ore blocks smeltable.
body:
This datapack makes the raw ore blocks smeltable. The time taken and xp reward of the blocks is 9x the amount of the ore equivalent. 
The purpose of this pack was to add the convenience of smelting the blocks instead of just the ore, not to make the smelting of the ore faster.
